races.paceDynamic: Static Charm, Knock Off Soxs, and Phantom Gold will ensure a proper gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners unlikely to yield easily. The strong pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over this 2m½f trip on good ground. Hold-up horses like Alsakib and Karthala should benefit from the expected collapse of some pace-setters in the final half-mile. This race shape clearly favours hold-up performers and those with proven stamina who can pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and weaken markedly from 3f out
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfect tow into the race and have ample time to wind up their challenges. Alsakib and Karthala are ideally positioned to exploit the pace scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders drops out early, creating a more moderate gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with prominent racers able to stay closer to a steadier pace. Senator and Laristote can press forward earlier and avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Static Charm or Knock Off Soxs gets an easy lead and controls the fractions
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on the field and maintains stamina reserves for a strong finish. The pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage before the hold-up horses can respond.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Phantom Gold Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the 68-rated Phantom Gold uses his recent winning form to steal a march
scenarios.body: Despite his low rating, his 1-1 recent record and front-running style could catch higher-rated opponents napping. The veteran's experience at Bangor and current confidence could prove decisive.

watchPoints.text: Knock Off Soxs, Static Charm, and Phantom Gold must be watched closely early - if all three commit to the lead, the pace will be unsustainable
Alsakib's jumping under pressure - he's the most likely beneficiary of a strong pace but needs to handle the obstacles cleanly when asked to quicken
Senator's position turning for home - if Jamie Snowden's runner is still on the bridle in fourth or fifth approaching the final two flights, he becomes very dangerous
The claimer rides on Static Charm and Knock Off Soxs - both 5lb claimers could get caught up in a speed duel that neither can afford
Phantom Gold's stamina reserves - his recent wins were over shorter trips and he may not last home if the pace becomes truly searching

races.paceDynamic: Subtle Fortune will lead unchallenged early with six runners (Streamsforth Lad, Black Occ, Sandscape, Atlanta Brave, Peckforton Hills, Kapamazov, El Rojo Grande) creating dangerous congestion behind in prominent positions. This prominent pack will create significant traffic problems approaching the business end, with horses struggling for racing room 2-3 out. The combination of a soft early lead and inevitable prominent scrambling means the race strongly favours either the lone leader Subtle Fortune or the hold-up horses (Siege Of Acres, Tory Hill, Rockvale, Huckleberry Sting) who can avoid the carnage and pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Soft Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Subtle Fortune gets an uncontested lead and stays galloping
scenarios.body: The prominent bunch gets in each other's way while Subtle Fortune builds an unassailable advantage, staying clear when the cavalry charges. His recent course form and amateur jockey's 7lb claim make him hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent traffic jam gets messy 2-3 out
scenarios.body: Siege Of Acres or Tory Hill can weave through the faltering prominent runners and sweep past a tiring leader up the hill. The McCain yard's excellent 6/22 strike rate gives Siege Of Acres the professional edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent pack gets first run on the field
scenarios.body: Kapamazov or El Rojo Grande times their move perfectly before the traffic develops, using superior RPR figures to overwhelm Subtle Fortune. Their class tells when it matters most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Subtle Fortune stops suddenly and the prominent bunch stalls
scenarios.body: The entire pace scenario falls apart leaving moderate hold-up horses like Huckleberry Sting to inherit a messy contest. Chaos reigns with no clear pace narrative emerging.

watchPoints.text: Prominent traffic jam involving Streamsforth Lad, Kapamazov, Atlanta Brave, and Peckforton Hills will create chaos 2-3 out
Subtle Fortune's amateur jockey Mr Darren Andrews may get swamped by more experienced riders in the closing stages
El Rojo Grande's three recent wins suggest he's the form horse if he can navigate the prominent congestion
Siege Of Acres needs to be produced with a clear run to utilise his hold-up style effectively
Track Tory Hill for a late surge at big odds if the pace collapses as expected

races.paceDynamic: Reckless Spending will lead from flag to finish with Park Princess and Pottersville tracking closely in the prominent positions, creating a steady but not pressured tempo over this extended trip. The trio of prominent runners will dictate a sustainable gallop that allows the race to develop naturally without early burn-up. Patrick's Wells and Johnny Moonshine sit as the only hold-up horses but face a significant class deficit against the front three. This pace setup strongly favours the prominent racers who can control their own destiny and kick from advantageous positions.

scenarios.title: Prominent Domination
scenarios.trigger: If the three class horses (Reckless Spending, Park Princess, Pottersville) maintain their expected positions without interference
scenarios.body: The trio travel comfortably in the first three slots before the best kicks clear in the straight. The hold-up pair never get competitive against superior opposition who control the race.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.body: Patrick's Wells or Johnny Moonshine benefit from a collapse in front. The reduced field creates opportunities for horses finishing from off the pace.

scenarios.label: D

races.paceDynamic: They Want Me is the only genuine front runner and will dictate terms without pressure from the start. The prominent group of Shengai Enki, Crack Ops, and I've Madeupmymind will sit tracking but none are aggressive early pace forcers. This sets up a comfortable tempo through the early stages with the real race unfolding from 3 out when the hold-up horses Sutherland, Killycarn, and Lejo Du Seuil need to make their moves. The lack of genuine pace pressure favours horses that can finish strongly from off the pace, with hold-up performers getting the ideal scenario of a steady gallop followed by a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If They Want Me sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays steady to 3 out
scenarios.body: The lack of early burn-up leaves plenty in reserve for the closers who get their preferred strong finish. Sutherland and Killycarn can unleash their best tactical weapons in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the tracking trio applies pressure to They Want Me from halfway
scenarios.body: This creates a more genuine test that exposes the stamina limitations of pure hold-up horses while suiting those with tactical speed. Shengai Enki or Crack Ops can capitalize on ideal positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: They Want Me wires field
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner maintains comfortable splits and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader exploits the lack of early pace pressure to dictate ideal fractions for staying on. None of the followers can match a determined front runner with first run advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If They Want Me goes too slow and the field bunches into 2 out
scenarios.body: An overly sedate gallop turns this into a cavalry charge where traffic problems decide the outcome. The best jumper with clearest passage can emerge from the pack.

watchPoints.text: They Want Me could get uncontested lead and prove impossible to peg back if allowed comfortable splits
Vinnie O'Neil has fading tendencies that could undermine any hold-up scenario despite the tactical setup
Crack Ops and Shengai Enki are best placed to apply pressure if they choose to challenge the front runner early
I've Madeupmymind faces fitness concerns after 57-day break for trainer struggling with strike rate
Sutherland and Killycarn have the profiles to benefit most if the pace sets up for strong finishers

The sustained tempo will test stamina reserves in the closing stages, particularly if both leaders maintain their early positions. This pace scenario clearly favours the hold-up horses who can conserve energy and deliver late finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If both Eremenko and I C U In My Dreams maintain the early lead and engage seriously
scenarios.body: The dual pace ensures a strong gallop that will drain the leaders' reserves over this staying trip. The hold-up brigade led by Diamond Jim, Las Canals and Tramuntana can time late challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of Eremenko or I C U In My Dreams can establish a clear lead and control the tempo

winners: I C U In My Dreams

scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too slow early and turn the race into a sprint finish

races.paceDynamic: Speed Davis holds the key as the sole confirmed front-runner in this 9-runner field, likely to dictate terms from the front without serious pressure. With Kintail the only other prominent runner, Speed Davis should get an uncontested lead and set a sustainable gallop over this 2m7f trip. The majority of the field are hold-up horses including Tiger Orchid, Dwight K Schrute, Our Dylan, and Golden Glance, creating a tactical contest where the pace will likely be moderate early. This setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the scramble, as the hold-up brigade will need the pace to collapse to be effective.

scenarios.title: Speed Davis Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Speed Davis gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The veteran can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back up the hill with most rivals needing to come from behind. His recent Southwell win shows he retains ability when getting his own way in front.
